subject.title: fix: provider usage accounting, retry/overflow classification, and output clamping

question: Should OpenClaw redefine an omitted Anthropic maxRetries value as zero and expose allowEmptySignature as a supported public model-compatibility option in this PR?
rationale: Both choices alter public provider or plugin-facing contracts, and repository policy requires explicit ownership of their default, upgrade, and configuration behavior rather than inferring intent from the implementation.

options.title: Preserve defaults and wire opt-in compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing unset retry contract, pass zero only from outer-retry callers, and fully expose and test allowEmptySignature through supported model loading.

options.title: Approve the new defaults
options.body: Intentionally define omitted Anthropic retries as zero and document and prove the compatibility and upgrade effects across all callers and provider paths.

options.title: Split contract changes out
options.body: Land independent accounting and classifier fixes separately while deferring retry-default and compatibility-surface decisions to a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Preserve defaults and wire opt-in compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the existing unset retry contract, pass zero only from outer-retry callers, and fully expose and test allowEmptySignature through supported model loading.
